name: ze_Pt9_LTA
title: Pt9 @ LTA (alpha cage)
description: Pt9 cluster in the alpha cage (11.4 A) of a frozen all-silica LTA framework (ITQ-29; NEP89-relaxed, fcc-type 2x supercell, 144 framework atoms). Pt, Pd and Rh clusters encapsulated in LTA were prepared by Choi, Wu and Iglesia (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 132, 9129 (2010)). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative (NEP89 GM: planar Pt9 lying flat on the cage wall).
